dedupe_keys.name: nest building energy occupancy geometry and validation data

description: The NEST building research team publishes energy-demand and user-practice observations for its DFAB, UMAR and SolAce units. Separate CSV files cover July 2019 to July 2023 at one-minute resolution, with metadata for 42, 27 and 18 measurement points respectively. The collection also supplies occupancy tables, preprocessing thresholds, floor plans, IFC and Revit geometry, and R Markdown quality-assessment code. All eight inspected Figshare deposits are publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. These inputs can calibrate building-control and energy-demand simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that the three experimental units are not representative of general building stock. Occupancy detail is limited and sensor quality varies. Some deposit descriptions incorrectly call the four-year span one year, so coverage follows the dated file manifest. No sensor values, geometry files or code were downloaded or tested.
